basic_details.job_title: PM SHRI KV ITBP Shivpuri Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 3 TGT, PGT and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya ITBP Shivpuri will hold a walk-in interview on 18 November 2026 (Wednesday). Registration and document check run from 09:00 am to 09:30 am, and the interview starts at 10:00 am. The interview is to form a panel of part-time contractual teachers for session 2026-27 for PGT (Chemistry), TGT (English) and ATL Instructor. Remuneration is as per KVS norms.

age_limit.details: The notice gives an age limit of 18-65 years for the posts. It prints no "as on" date for age and no relaxations. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

B.E, B.Tech, Electronic & Communication; minimum one year experience in relevant field

content_sections.heading: PM SHRI KV ITBP Shivpuri Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notice does not specify the number of vacancies, the last date or the application fee.

rows.details: 09:00 am - 09:30 am (registration and document check); interview from 10:00 am
Eligible and willing candidates aged 18-65 years, registered on the KVS Samvida Sathi Portal

content_sections.heading: About PM SHRI KV ITBP Shivpuri
content_sections.text: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya ITBP Shivpuri is a Kendriya Vidyalaya in Shivpuri. The school lists telephone 07492 – 292120, email [email protected] and website https://itbpshivpuri.kvs.ac.in/ . The notice is for a panel of part-time contractual teachers for session 2026-27. This is a contractual engagement, not a regular post.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Two years integrated post graduate course of Regional College of Education of NCERT in the concerned subject, or Master's Degree in the subject with minimum 50% marks in aggregate from a recognized university. B.Ed or equivalent from a Recognized University (at least 50% marks). Proficiency in Hindi & English. Desirable: Knowledge in Computer Applications. Four years integrated degree course of Regional College of Education of NCERT in the concerned subject with at least 50% in aggregate, OR Bachelor's Degree with at least 50% marks in the concerned subjects/combination of subjects and in aggregate, OR One year B.Ed. (Special Education) from Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) with at least 50% marks. B.Ed. or equivalent degree from a Recognized University. Pass in Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) Paper-II, conducted by CBSE. Proficiency in teaching in Hindi & English medium. Desirable: Knowledge of Computer Applications. B.E, B.Tech, Electronic & Communication. Minimum one year experience in relevant field. The notice gives an age limit of 18-65 years for the posts. It prints no "as on" date for age and no relaxations. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: Master Degree in Chemistry from a recognized University with at least 50% marks in aggregate (provided the candidate has studied the concerned subject at graduation level)

English as a subject in all the three years of Graduation with at least 50% marks OR Post-Graduation in the concerned subject with a minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade, or three years integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed. from an NCTE recognized institution/University with at least 50% marks (see the TGT essential qualifications below)
B.E, B.Tech, Electronic & Communication; minimum one year experience in relevant field

content_sections.heading: Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The posts are purely on contractual basis; remuneration is as per KVS norms. Selected candidates will be called as and when a vacancy arises, in order of priority in the panel. No TA/DA will be admissible for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: A copy of the bio-data form (Walk-in Interview Proforma 2026-27). Photograph (the proforma says not to pin up or staple it). Self-attested copies of the required certificates. Original documents for verification. Copy of the category certificate (SC/ST/OBC), attached to the proforma. Attested copies of mark sheets and certificates for professional qualifications. The proforma asks for post applied for, name, father's/husband's name, date of birth, address, mobile and WhatsApp number, email, category, educational and professional qualifications, and experience. It also asks whether the candidate can teach through English and Hindi and has knowledge of computer applications, and carries an undertaking to be signed.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Registration and document check take place from 09:00 am to 09:30 am. Applications are accepted only during this time on the interview day. The interview begins at 10:00 am. Selected candidates are placed in the panel and called when a vacancy arises, in order of priority.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Online registration on the KVS Samvida Sathi Portal is mandatory for all candidates who want to be in the contractual teachers' panel. Candidates attend at their own expense. Mere eligibility does not confer a right to be called for interview or selection. Candidature may be cancelled if any information is found incorrect on verification. The qualification, service conditions and application form format are available on the school website https://itbpshivpuri.kvs.ac.in/ .

faq.question: Q1. When is the PM SHRI KV ITBP Shivpuri walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 18 November 2026 (Wednesday). Registration and document check are from 09:00 am to 09:30 am, and the interview starts at 10:00 am.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are covered?
faq.answer: The posts are PGT (Chemistry), TGT (English) and ATL Instructor, for a part-time contractual panel for session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for PGT (Chemistry)?
faq.answer: A Master Degree in Chemistry from a recognized University with at least 50% marks in aggregate, plus B.Ed or equivalent with at least 50% marks and proficiency in Hindi & English.

faq.question: Q4. What is required for the ATL Instructor post?
faq.answer: B.E, B.Tech, Electronic & Communication, with a minimum of one year experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q5. Is CTET required for TGT (English)?
faq.answer: Yes. The TGT essential qualifications include a pass in CTET Paper-II conducted by CBSE, along with B.Ed. or equivalent.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice gives an age limit of 18-65 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Remuneration is as per KVS norms. The notice prints no amount.

faq.question: Q8. What should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring a copy of the bio-data form, a photograph, self-attested copies of the required certificates and the originals for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is registration on the KVS Samvida Sathi Portal needed?
faq.answer: Yes. Online registration on the KVS Samvida Sathi Portal is mandatory for all candidates who wish to join the contractual teachers' panel.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be admissible for attending the interview.
